name: eczid-api-trust
description: See which API surfaces a workspace exposes, how they are secured and whether they carry public proof: OpenAPI / GraphQL / AsyncAPI contracts, catalogues, auth configuration, disclosure contacts and contract tests. Inspection only. Free.

interface.shortDescription: Review API surfaces in a repo
interface.longDescription: See which API surfaces a workspace exposes and how they are described: OpenAPI, GraphQL and AsyncAPI contracts, API catalogues and discovery files, authentication and authorisation configuration, security policy and disclosure contacts, contract tests and request collections, and any ECZ-ID public proof reference. A local, filename-and-path-only review that reports EVIDENCE OBSERVED / NOT OBSERVED and a deterministic Review Priority. Inspection only.
defaultPrompt: Review this workspace's API surfaces and report the Review Priority.
